control_flow: avoidWalls: if the left light is below 30 %, check LEFT then RIGHT obstacles (curve away) or else call driveInTheDark; if not below 30 %, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the front obstacle sensor sees something, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: In a dark tunnel, steer away from the walls so the robot gets through a bending tunnel without touching it.

scenarios.coded_response: The left light reads 40 %, not below 30 %, so avoidWalls goes on to driveInTheDark, which sees 40 % below 70 % and drives straight forward at 30 %; it never reads the left or right obstacle sensor.

scenarios.title: Steers away from the walls in a bending tunnel
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns away from the wall that comes close on its left or right and gets through the bend without touching the tunnel.

scenarios.coded_response: The light is 70 % or more, so it calls stopAtWall, whose front sensor sees the wall, so it stops.

scenarios.title: Stops at a wall in bright light

scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without touching it.

scenarios.coded_response: The light is 70 % or more and nothing is ahead, so it calls followLine: it curves left on black and right on the floor.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in bright light on a line, with nothing in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the floor, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line in bright light
assumptions: The line-following curves suggest the robot should follow the line to its end.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end.
